description: This is an abstract Java test class for testing message consumers in a messaging connectivity service. It defines test methods for inbound message processing, acknowledgment handling, and error scenarios, utilizing Akka actors, Mockito, and JUnit. The class sets up testing infrastructure, mocks dependencies, and provides abstract methods for subclasses to specify specifics of the actual consumer being tested.

classes.name: AbstractConsumerActorTest
classes.description: An abstract JUnit test class designed to test message consumer actors within a messaging service, providing infrastructure for inbound message simulation, acknowledgment handling, and error scenario testing.

methods.name: testInboundMessage
methods.description: Tests processing of inbound messages with specified headers, verifying signals and responses.

methods.name: testInboundMessageWitMultipleMappingsSucceeds
methods.description: Tests inbound message handling with multiple mappings to verify correct processing.

methods.name: testPositiveSourceAcknowledgementSettlement
methods.description: Verifies acknowledgment handling when the process succeeds.

methods.name: testNegativeSourceAcknowledgementSettlementDueToError
methods.description: Verifies acknowledgment handling when an error occurs during processing.

methods.name: testNegativeSourceAcknowledgementSettlementDueToNAck
methods.description: Tests acknowledgment handling when a negative acknowledgment (NAck) is expected.

methods.name: testNegativeSourceAcknowledgementSettlementDueToTimeout
methods.description: Tests acknowledgment handling when a timeout occurs.

methods.name: testNegativeSourceAcknowledgementSettlementDueToServerError
methods.description: Tests acknowledgment handling when the server reports an error.

methods.name: testInboundMessageFails
methods.description: Tests message processing failure when required headers are missing or invalid.

methods.name: testInboundMessageFailsIfHeaderIsMissing
methods.description: Ensures processing fails if essential headers are missing in the message.

methods.name: testInboundMessageWithHeaderMapping
methods.description: Tests message processing with header mappings.

methods.name: testInboundMessageWithHeaderMappingThrowsUnresolvedPlaceholderException
methods.description: Verifies that unresolved placeholders in headers cause exceptions as expected.

methods.name: setupMessageMappingProcessorActor
methods.description: Sets up the message processing actor hierarchy for testing with mock configuration.
